changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAsset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAsset]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectTypeID] [int] NULL, [ProposedKey] [varchar](32) NULL, [ParentUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [ParentAssetID] [bigint] NULL, [ParentObject] [varchar](50) NULL, [ParentObjectID] [int] NULL, [ParentObjectType] [varchar](50) NULL, [ParentObjectTypeID] [int] NULL, [IntersectTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [IsNew] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionAsset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Asset') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Asset] ON [api].[ExecutionAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [AssetID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Object') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Object] ON [api].[ExecutionAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_ProposedKey') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionAsset_ProposedKey] ON [api].[ExecutionAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ProposedKey] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Success') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Success] ON [api].[ExecutionAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Success] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from information_schema.columns where table_schema='api' and table_name = 'ExecutionAsset' and column_name = 'UpdateGraph') begin alter table api.ExecutionAsset add UpdateGraph bit constraint DF_ApiExecutionAsset_UpdateGraph default(0) not null end
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_UpdateGraph') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_ApiExecutionAsset_UpdateGraph on api.ExecutionAsset (ExecutionID asc, UpdateGraph asc) END
changeSet.rollback: alter table api.ExecutionAsset DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS DF_ApiExecutionAsset_UpdateGraph drop index if exists IX_ApiExecutionAsset_UpdateGraph on api.ExecutionAsset alter table api.ExecutionAsset DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS UpdateGraph

changeSet.author: Puneet gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Uid') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Uid on api.ExecutionAsset (Uid asc) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Uid') BEGIN drop index if exists IX_ApiExecutionAsset_Uid on api.ExecutionAsset END
